# Provider Response Fixtures

These fixtures capture representative provider response shapes checked against official docs on 2026-04-28. Values are intentionally synthetic, but the usage field names mirror the documented APIs.

- OpenRouter usage accounting: https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/administration/usage-accounting
- OpenAI Responses API: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses/create
- OpenAI Chat Completions API: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create
- Anthropic Messages API and service tiers: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages and https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/service-tiers
- Google Gemini GenerateContent: https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content
- xAI prompt caching usage: https://docs.x.ai/developers/advanced-api-usage/prompt-caching/usage-and-pricing
